2.211.14
MapColorScale.MapSize
Applies to RDL 2010/01 and RDL 2016/01
The MapColorScale.MapSize element specifies the size of a MapColorScale. This element is optional.
If this element is not present, the color scale size MUST be automatically calculated. This element is of
type MapSize.
The following is the parent element of the MapColorScale.MapSize element.
Parent elements
MapColorScale
The following is the XML Schema definition of the MapColorScale.MapSize element.
 <xsd:element name="MapSize" type="MapSizeType" minOccurs="0" />
